Representation level: L1 (proxy). CineRecon Three.js sampled-frame baseline (not a Blender-protocol reproduction).

Observed in the 24 reference samples: meadow, far tree line, windmill; a scout boy (fur hat, olive uniform, orange backpack, yellow top roll, two end-on bedrolls, long stick) and a girl (pink dress, auburn hair, wicker basket, binoculars, yellow suitcase, teal case/red book). Shots (cut instants inferred between samples): A 0-4.1 s boy stands facing image-left, picks a flower (~1.5 s), walks left from ~2.8 s with the camera trucking left; B 4.1-7.83 s girl at frame-left over her suitcase, bends and picks it up (~5.2-5.6 s), walks image-right with camera trucking right; C 7.83-12.33 s boy walks image-left with bouquet and a paper, camera tracking (slightly higher horizon); D/E 12.33 s-end girl walks right, the tracking camera settles, boy enters from image-right (~14.9 s), girl sets the suitcase down (~15.5 s), boy hands her the flowers (~16 s), they study an unfolded map.

Geometry: boxes/cylinders/spheres/cones for kids and props; seeded vertex-coloured ground; ellipsoid tree line; slim weed cones; windmill proxy; camera-attached letterbox bars as in the reference.
Articulation: hierarchical skeletons (spine, head, shoulders, elbows, hips, knees, ankles), distance-driven gait with stance foot kept on the ground, crouch/bend for pick-up and put-down, a one-bone reach IK so the girl's right hand meets the suitcase handle, arm reach to pick the flower, flower handover, two-handed map holding. Suitcase, bouquet, case and map follow hand world positions.
Camera: perspective, vFOV 30 deg, height 1.2 m (1.25 in shot C), pitch -8.7 deg (-6.8 in shot C); per-shot analytic truck paths derived from subject screen positions and windmill parallax; hard cuts.

Feedback received: round 1 render pairs for all 24 samples. Revisions in this round: suitcase now rests on the ground at reference positions in shots B and E (was floating at hand height), reach IK added; unfolded map moved to waist/chest height, smaller and tilted (was covering the girl's face); shot C pitch/height corrected to the lower horizon; boy x in shot A walk adjusted; girl moved closer in shot B; trees made lower/smaller; weed cones thinned; D/E camera path shifted slightly.
Remaining discrepancies/unverified: proxy appearance (flat colours, no grass texture), exact cut frames, unobserved boy speed between shots C and E, approximate handover timing.
